notes: AI-native solo dev/consultant. Already adopts open-source tools. Can install a CLI in 5 min. Pain: Claude/OpenAI dependency + vendor-lock + no proof of AI work. Fits doctrine exactly (alone-first, Dema-first, receipted). Business-model fit LOW-MEDIUM: they won't pay immediately; they'll adopt free and refer. Launch friction LOW: CLI install on macOS/Linux.

Knowledge worker drowning in multi-device files, multiple AI subscriptions, scattered notes. Pain is REAL but diffuse — they want 'my AI to know me' not 'a receipted mission runtime'. Receipt value prop does not resonate initially. Dema CLI is too technical for them today. Would need browser/GUI face to onboard (future, per bizra-now-vs-future-image-v1.md).

Substack writers, educators, solo consultants packaging expertise. Pain: can't prove what their AI did for a client; can't bill per verified output. Fits output-as-a-service business model well. Needs Dema CLI + receipt-sharing surface. Weakest point: no direct corpus evidence this archetype is asking for receipted AI.

Small (5-50 person) team using AI agents without audit trail. Pain is present but team-level solutions require multi-user features BIZRA doesn't have yet. Switch costs high (already wired to LangChain/CrewAI). Launch friction HIGH: needs enterprise sales motion BIZRA lacks. Not first wedge.

Enterprise security/governance role. Pain validated by EU AI Act + 60+ country data-localization laws (real signal). BUT: long sales cycle, RFP-driven, requires pilots BIZRA has not yet run. Business model fit HIGHEST ($50-200K/yr per corpus) but not first-wedge accessible. Needs v1.0.0 + 24-hr heartbeat + multiple customer pilots first.

Crypto-adjacent, Islamic-finance-adjacent, or explicit sovereignty-believer. Will adopt early on ideological grounds. Business-model fit LOW (won't pay; they're builders, not buyers). Critical for bootstrapping network effects + word-of-mouth. A1's ideological twin. Overlap: most A1s have some A6.

Banking/finance/healthcare/legal compliance officer or auditor. Pain is regulation-mandated (EU AI Act Article 13). Willingness-to-switch LOW — requires vendor procurement. Trust and receipt value prop perfect. NOT first wedge — needs BIZRA v1.0.0 + external evidence bundle + customer references.

Developer watching Claude quota exhaustion + OpenAI pricing / rate-limit pain. Wants model-portability + local fallback. Dema's verificative layer (not generative) appeals as 'governance over whichever LLM I use today'. Overlap with A1 — solo builders often also hyperscaler-anxious. Receipt proof is secondary for them; model-independence is primary.
